report: All three sisters have agreed on a first step: locate the will and the executor, confirm each sister's share of the house, and split the cost of one independent professional valuation. No price, discount, or sale has been agreed, and C has made clear she reserves the right to decline any discounted purchase. A has said she will keep everyone posted once the will and executor are found. B's wish to use her share for a dance studio is on the shared list of concerns, along with A's goal of financial independence and C's requirement of a fair share. The plan is waiting on the will and valuation; I'd pick the conversation up from there if asked. I have not given legal advice or handled any money.
